data.long_meaning: The meaning of Fotinas is recorded in name-lists as “Gift of God”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Fotinas expresses “Gift of God”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fotinas total 30, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: Fotinas
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Gift of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fotinas הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'otheinos', meaning 'of God'. This name was given to honor the divine intervention in one's life.

in_latin.name: Fotinas
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Gift of God
in_latin.long_meaning: Fotinas est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word 'otheinos', meaning 'of God'. This name was given to honor the divine intervention in one's life.
